name: task-timeline
title: TaskTimeline
description: Lifecycle of an A2A task: state tags, a chain of states that can select the steps of a script, and a state-machine diff of lanes (expected versus actual).

a11y.pattern: <ol aria-label> of <li>; each state is a <span> (read-only) or a <button aria-pressed> (selects a step). Lanes are named <ol>s inside a group
keyboard: Moves between the state buttons of a selectable timeline
Selects the step of the state, or clears it when it is already selected
aria: The state is always written ("input-required"); the glyph is aria-hidden and its shape differs per state
State buttons read "working at +300 ms, show in script" and use aria-pressed
The text on a link between two states (a user reply) is real text, the rule and chevron are CSS shapes
Unreached end states are dashed tags under "other end states", not an empty list
Lane nodes with a tone add an icon and a hidden word (legal or illegal); the red outline is never the only signal
a11y.notes: Put the same sequence as a table or a log elsewhere on the page when the timing matters. Rejected and canceled stay neutral: they are outcomes of a request, not failures of the task.
